title: OpenEPCIS extension (permissive): eudr
description: Permissive capture schema for the https://ref.openepcis.io/extensions/eu/eudr/ extension. Declares known terms as optional and allows additional properties, so events that declare GS1-Extensions eudr=https://ref.openepcis.io/extensions/eu/eudr/ validate and capture. Generated from the module JSON-LD context; tighten per ontology for field-level validation.

eudr:areaHectares.x-access-level-rationale: Plot area without coordinates supports plausibility checks of the due diligence but is not needed by the public; the coordinates themselves are Restricted.
